description: Land Acquisition - Bandagane, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and original claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
